collection.title: Demo Interview & Aptitude Prep
collection.description: High-impact technical interview problems and behavioral frameworks for undergraduate engineering students.
collection.scopeLabel: 5 sample interview questions across CS & Management

items.subject: Computer Science
items.body: Given a sorted array of integers, design an algorithm to find two numbers that sum up to a specific target value. What is the asymptotic time and space complexity?

items.subject: Systems Design
items.body: Explain the trade-offs described by the CAP theorem. Why cannot a distributed data store simultaneously provide Consistency, Availability, and Partition tolerance in the presence of network partitions?

items.subject: Computer Science
items.body: Contrast **Read Committed** and **Repeatable Read** transaction isolation levels. Describe a scenario that causes a *Phantom Read* anomaly under Repeatable Read in ANSI SQL standard.

items.subject: Behavioral
items.body:
Structure every behavioral answer using **STAR**:
- **S**ituation: Context and problem background (15% time)
- **T**ask: Your specific responsibility or hurdle (15% time)
- **A**ction: The step-by-step engineering decisions YOU made (50% time)
- **R**esult: Quantifiable impact, metrics, and learnings (20% time)

items.subject: Computer Science
items.body: What are the four Coffman conditions necessary for a deadlock to occur in a multiprogramming system? How does prevention differ from deadlock avoidance?
